description: This file contains server-side code for the Admin Panel in an online examination system, managing navigation between different pages like Admin Queue, Leaderboard, Set Exam, Edit Exam, and Login.

classes.name: AdminPanel
classes.description: Code-behind class for AdminPanel page, handling navigation button clicks.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Event handler for page load; currently does nothing.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Event handler for the home button click; currently does nothing.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Transfers user to the Admin Queue page.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Transfers user to the Admin Leaderboard page.

methods.name: sExamB_Click
methods.description: Transfers user to the Set Exam page.

methods.name: eExamB_Click
methods.description: Transfers user to the Edit Exam page.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Transfers user to the Login page, effectively logging out.
